ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

2. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.

3. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.

4. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.

5. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

6. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. quickly
   C. blue
   D. happiness

7. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library

8. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. going

9. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

10. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Only one word repeated

12. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.

13. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

14. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.

15. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
